claims.statement: Tom Allen says Charlie Mitchell must beat Jim Corbett.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen says emphatically that Charlie Mitchell must win against Champion Jim Corbett

claims.statement: Tom Allen was born in Birmingham.
claims.excerpt: that, first, Tom Allen was bornin Birmingham, and, secondly, so was

claims.statement: Tom Allen backed Ed Smith, a Birmingham man, against Joe Goddard.
claims.excerpt: figuring along the lines of this ratiocinative process that actuated Tom to back Ed Smith

claims.statement: Tom Allen won heavily on his bet on Ed Smith against Joe Goddard.
claims.excerpt: The fact that Smith was originally from Birmingham and Goddard was not was all-sufficient and Tom Piled his winning shekels high

claims.statement: Tom Allen believes a man born in Birmingham can always beat a man not born in Birmingham.
claims.excerpt: as sure as the sun rises and sets a man born in Birmingham can always lick a man not born in Birmingham

notes: Mitchell prediction and birthplace are as the paper reports them; the tone is teasing but the facts are stated plainly.
